notes.title: Psycho 1.6 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
* Decrease default Eric's running speed from 330 to 300.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
* Mouse stuck on the screen after closing the pause menu
* Settings menu still appears on the screen after closing the pause menu.

notes.title: Psycho 1.4 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
* Press RMB instead of LMB for fixing the generators

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
* Can't pick up dead body near the generators
* Player can stand on the barrel at zone B3.
* AI stuck while in the radiation time

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38890262/9dfe7ab1212a4cb6b7f9b5d5091142b1f8aa8658.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Psycho 1.3 Update
notes.content:
[h2]New[/h2]
* Added recovery room guide at the beginning

[h2]Changes[/h2]
* Decrease default Eric's running speed from 340 to 330.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
* Objective reset back to "Find Office 05" after respawning from the death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38890262/1ec53d6fc894d18a1098bde8f840a0db62a5e495.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Psycho 1.2 Update
notes.content:
[h2]New[/h2]
* Added more David doll on the ground.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
* Decrease default Eric's running speed from 350 to 340.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
* No game-ending after all players are dead
* No achievement update after game-ending
